nobunaga.name: 織田信長
nobunaga.character: 威嚴、帶粗獷邊緣的中低男聲；果斷、命令式收尾。
nobunaga.description: Adult Japanese male warlord, forties. A commanding resonant low baritone, dry metallic rasp and clear hard consonants. Proud authoritative presence and decisive phrasing. Preserve a mature masculine chest timbre with a bright cutting edge when exerting force. Natural chest speaking register approximately 120-170 Hz, with forceful changing emphasis rather than a thin high tenor.
nobunaga.speaker: Ryan

oichi.name: 阿市
oichi.character: 明亮、有支撐的成熟女聲；發力俐落、受擊短促痛呼，勝利清楚自信。
oichi.description: Adult Japanese woman warrior, late twenties. Clear ringing athletic soprano, mature feminine timbre, crisp articulation and strong diaphragm support. Fearless confident heroine. Firm fully voiced vowels; clean forward resonance, never breathy, whispery, coquettish or childlike. Natural clear adult feminine speaking register approximately 250-330 Hz; athletic effort and pain may rise sharply while staying fully voiced.
oichi.speaker: Ono_Anna

hideyoshi.name: 豐臣秀吉
hideyoshi.character: 明亮偏高、稍沙啞的男聲；節奏快速，機靈豪爽。
hideyoshi.description: Adult Japanese male warrior, thirties. Bright nimble tenor with a slightly nasal brassy edge and light rasp, quick crisp rhythm. Wily bold exuberant personality and a confident grin. Clearly adult masculine timbre. Natural adult masculine speaking register approximately 180-250 Hz; agile energetic emphasis, not a shrill falsetto.
victories: どうじゃ！わしに任せて正解じゃろ！
よしよし！勝ち鬨を上げい！
まだまだ！天下はこれからじゃ！
victory_subtitles: 還早呢！天下才正要開始！
hideyoshi.speaker: Eric

ieyasu.name: 德川家康
ieyasu.character: 溫厚、厚實的低男中音；沉著、耐心、穩定收尾。
ieyasu.description: Mature Japanese male commander, fifties. Full rounded low baritone with warm thick chest resonance. Steady resolute authority, strong supported vocal projection. Controlled force and clear deliberate articulation; powerful rather than timid. Natural low male chest speaking register approximately 90-150 Hz; expressive resolute emphasis with a solid bass foundation.
victories: 生き残った。それが何よりだ。
焦ることはない。一歩ずつ進もう。
皆、よく耐えた。勝利は我らにある。
victory_subtitles: 活下來了。這比什麼都重要。
無須焦急。一步一步前進吧。
大家撐得很好。勝利屬於我們。
ieyasu.speaker: Dylan

mitsuhide.name: 明智光秀
mitsuhide.character: 清晰、乾冷的中高男聲；咬字精準、克制而銳利。
mitsuhide.description: Adult Japanese male swordsman, forties. Focused clear middle tenor with dry narrow resonance, crisp precise consonants and a steely cutting edge. Intense disciplined resolve; controlled muscular vocal support and audible conviction. Natural adult masculine speaking register approximately 150-200 Hz; sharp emotional conviction within a clear male middle register.
victories: 迷いは捨てた。ただ、進むのみ。
この刃が、道を切り開く。
mitsuhide.speaker: Aiden

tadakatsu.name: 本多忠勝
tadakatsu.character: 粗厚低男聲；攻擊有爆發力，受傷有緊咬疼痛感，必殺與討取激昂有力。
tadakatsu.description: Adult Japanese male warrior, forties, exceptionally strong imposing physique. Deep dark rough bass-baritone with thick chest resonance and a gritty edge. Fearless heroic battlefield presence. Powerful diaphragm support, hard consonants and forceful changing emphasis; retain deep masculine timbre while shouting with real physical effort. A true very low male chest speaking register around 90-120 Hz, strongly resonant and roughly textured. Emphatic changes of stress and pitch remain in a deep bass register. Use muscular chest power and gritty explosive articulation rather than shrill high-register projection.
tadakatsu.intro: 本多忠勝だ。背中は、わしに任せよ。
victories: 守るべき者は、すべて守った。
敵は討った。背は任せよ。
victory_subtitles: 該守護的人，我全都守住了。
tadakatsu.speaker: Uncle_Fu

delivery.intro: A projected heroic battlefield self-introduction to comrades. Firm ready-for-battle energy, lively deliberate emphasis, finish with resolve. Clearly performed as a warrior entering combat, not a flat documentary reading.
delivery.attack: One single sharp energetic martial-arts kiai, roughly 0.4 seconds. Physical effort driving a weapon strike: hard consonant attack, forceful fully voiced projection and abrupt decisive stop. One compact burst only. Not a spoken reading of a syllable, whisper, sigh, gasp or drawn-out moan.
delivery.heavy: One explosive full-force martial strike shout, roughly 0.4 seconds. Powerful diaphragm pressure, muscular vocal strain and a hard ringing attack, rising effort then a clipped finish. Retain the character's voice but give substantially more effort than conversational speech. No extra breath, repeated syllable, lingering vowel, sigh or moan.
delivery.hurt: One involuntary sharp painful impact cry, roughly 0.4 seconds. Sudden injury and clenched-body pain: hard strained onset, a short disrupted vowel and a tight cutoff. Painful and distressed, not attacking or celebrating. No soft breathy pleasure tone, sensual moaning, lingering groan, panting or added inhale.
delivery.special: A forceful passionate named-attack battle cry. Project the exact Japanese move name across a noisy battlefield, accent the key syllables with increasing muscular effort and finish emphatically. Fierce resolve and clear consonants, never calm recitation. No added words or repeated shouts.
delivery.victory: A proud spirited victory declaration to battlefield comrades. Full voiced forward projection, meaningful changing stress and energized triumphant cadence. Keep the exact words. If the wording is playful, perform it with a bright confident smile and crisp articulation, never breathy seductive softness or moaning. Not flat narration.
delivery.defeat: The exact defeat line spoken through acute pain, exhaustion and sorrow after falling in combat. Strained broken support and palpable regret, clearly voiced words with weakening energy. A wounded warrior's last effort, not a calm statement, sensual whisper or prolonged moan.
delivery.boss_defeat: A loud triumphant military victory cry announcing the enemy general is defeated. Proud passionate battlefield projection, clear rising emphasis through the declaration and a decisive powerful ending. Treat this as a heroic announcement, never flat reading or casual conversation.
